purpose: Define the evidence required to progress VX4800 from repository-valid prototype design to first article, construction release and production release without confusing software/package checks with physical product qualification or certification.

validationBoundary.existingPackageValidationMeaning: Repository/package consistency and design-intent geometry only.

evidenceClasses.description: Versioned source, schema validation, deterministic builds, geometry QA and controlled digital schedules.
Exact manufacturer datasheets, declarations, certificates, photometry, component ratings and production traceability for the selected configuration.
Signed or controlled calculations, load cases, risk analysis, wiring calculations, thermal assessment and other engineering records based on controlled inputs.
Production-intent sample, subsystem, first-article or full-pre-hang measurements and tests with traceable setup, equipment, acceptance criteria and results.
Accredited laboratory, certification body, inspection body or authority evidence where the applicable market route requires it.

releaseStages.meaning: Digital design package is internally consistent enough to support controlled supplier/prototype work.
Representative physical subsystems are available for destructive/non-destructive engineering tests and motion trials.
A production-intent complete fixture is built and tested against the controlled evidence matrix.
Project-specific structure, site interface, product safety evidence and approved configuration are sufficient for manufacture/installation on the named project.
Controlled BOM/process/test requirements and conformity evidence support repeatable production of the approved variant.

evidenceMatrix.requirement: Freeze exact first-article BOM, drawings, software/firmware where applicable, material tier, suspension configuration, accent-head configuration and kinetic configuration.
Control actual complete installed mass, rotating mass, S/M/L suspended-assembly masses and center of gravity using traceable physical measurements.
Approve primary load path, site reactions, interface/anchor design, local stresses, deflection and design load cases using controlled masses and kinetic loads.
Select exact cable/gripper/terminal/lower-yoke system and pass production-equivalent pull, slip and fatigue qualification with resolved secondary retention.
Select exact ARC/LUX/ART production path and pass attachment proof/fatigue plus failure/fragment-retention requirements for the released tier.
Qualify bearing, drive, braking, service lock, secondary retention, balance, feedback, abnormal-torque handling, power-loss behavior and safe restart.
Demonstrate acceptable dynamic clearances and suspended-field behavior through representative and full-field testing, not visualization alone.
Freeze exact head/control gear, supply variant, wiring, protection, earthing/bonding, isolation, kinetic electrical safety and service architecture.
Complete applicable construction, earthing, terminal/wiring, electric-shock, insulation/electric-strength and related luminaire safety tests on the released configuration.
Complete applicable endurance/thermal tests and confirm component/wiring temperatures remain within selected-component and product limits under worst released operating conditions.
Control exact supplier/lab photometry for the selected head/optic configuration and validate intended optical performance independently before construction release.
Demonstrate representative replacement of heads, control gear, kinetic service items, suspension items and butterflies without destructive canopy access or unsafe motion exposure.
Complete full 240-element factory pre-hang and dynamic test on the production-intent first article, recording balance, motion, clearances, noise, vibration, line behavior and fault-stop performance.
Release correct rating/identification markings, installation instructions, service instructions, warnings, inspection requirements, commissioning record and approved configuration identifiers.
Complete documented first-article inspection against controlled drawings/BOM including dimensions, finishes, hardware, IDs, service access and deviations/dispositions.

rules: A passing GitHub Actions workflow cannot close a PHYSICAL or THIRD_PARTY evidence requirement.
Presentation, Blender, coordination GLB and repository-generated STEP/DXF are not manufacturing or certification evidence.
Supplier component certification does not certify the complete VX4800 fixture.
Construction release is project/configuration specific and cannot be inherited automatically by a changed material, head, driver, suspension, kinetic or structural configuration.
Any failed first-article test or unapproved deviation keeps the dependent promotion gate false until disposition and re-test are complete.
No standard is claimed applicable or satisfied solely because it appears in standardsTargets.
